opus.problem: Repeats facts already given by other clues: Pilate offering to release him instead of Jesus (clue 3), the crowd choosing him (clue 5), and his insurrection (clue 2). Only the Passover custom is new, so it should be the clue's single point.
Too easy, not medium hard. Being the man Pilate offered to release in place of Jesus is the one thing Barabbas is known for, so this clue alone gives the word away.
